verses.text: "Write this to the angel of the church in Ephesus: This is what the one says who holds the seven stars in his right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands:
I know what you do, how hard you work, and how you keep going. I know you cannot stand evil people. You have tested those who call themselves apostles but are not, and you found out they are liars.
You have kept going and have suffered for my name, and you have not given up.
But I have this against you: you have left the love you had at first.
So remember how far you have fallen. Turn back to God, and do the things you did at first. If you do not turn back, I will come to you and take your lampstand away from its place.
But you have this in your favour: you hate what the Nicolaitans do, which I also hate.
Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who wins the victory, I will give the right to eat from the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of God.
Write this to the angel of the church in Smyrna: This is what the one says who is the First and the Last, who died and came back to life:
I know your suffering and your poverty, but you are rich! I know the evil things said against you by those who say they are Jews but are not. They are a synagogue of Satan.

Do not be afraid of what you are about to suffer. Look, the devil will throw some of you into prison to test you, and you will suffer for ten days. Be faithful, even if it means death, and I will give you the crown of life.
Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who wins the victory will not be hurt by the second death.
Write this to the angel of the church in Pergamum: This is what the one says who has the sharp sword with two edges:
I know where you live, where Satan has his throne. Yet you hold on to my name. You did not give up your faith in me, even when Antipas, my faithful witness, was killed among you, where Satan lives.
But I have a few things against you. Some of you follow the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to make the people of Israel fall into sin. They ate food offered to idols and did sexual sin.
In the same way, some of you also follow the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
So turn back to God! If you do not, I will come to you soon and fight against them with the sword of my mouth.

Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who wins the victory, I will give some of the hidden manna. I will also give him a white stone with a new name written on it, a name no one knows except the one who receives it.
Write this to the angel of the church in Thyatira: This is what the Son of God says, whose eyes are like flames of fire and whose feet are like shining bronze:
I know what you do: your love, your faith, your service, and how you keep going. And I know that you are doing more now than you did at first.
But I have this against you: you allow that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophet. By her teaching she leads my servants into sexual sin and into eating food offered to idols.
I gave her time to turn away from her sexual sin, but she does not want to.
So I will throw her onto a bed of suffering. And those who commit adultery with her will suffer greatly, unless they turn away from what she does.
I will strike her children dead. Then all the churches will know that I am the one who looks deep into minds and hearts. I will pay back each of you for what you have done.
Now I speak to the rest of you in Thyatira, who do not follow her teaching and have not learned what some call 'the deep secrets of Satan.' I will not put any other load on you.
Only hold on tightly to what you have until I come.
To the one who wins the victory and keeps doing what I want until the end, I will give power over the nations.
He will rule them with an iron rod and smash them like clay pots, just as I have received power from my Father.
I will also give him the morning star.
Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
